assistant_text: The London hire option leads in roughly 64% of simulations. The two largest drivers are: (1) deeper domain expertise translates to ~£12K/month higher revenue capture, and (2) the 6-month onboarding ramp is offset by the team's higher hit-rate on the compliance feature. The offshoring option is competitive when timezone overlap is wide; in narrow-overlap scenarios the lead margin shrinks to ~3 percentage points.
